gotchas: setBoundVariableForPaint: seed the paint color with the variable value resolved in the default mode — some nodes render the stored fallback (0.5 gray) instead of the bound value
resize() before primaryAxisSizingMode=AUTO pins FIXED width — set sizing modes AFTER resize (Chip set came out 10px wide)
Paint opacity: spreading the paint returned by setBoundVariableForPaint drops opacity — assign fills first, then node.fills = node.fills.map(p => ({...p, opacity}))

Paint opacity on a variable-bound paint is NOT inherited by instances (fresh instance reads opacity 1, no override) — alpha must live in the variable (RGBA Color variable) or in layer opacity (node.opacity) where the code itself uses `opacity`. The 3a opacity remaps were rebound on 2026-09-07.
A BOOLEAN property can only hide the node it references — a state that hides one sibling and shows another (e.g. loading) must be a variant axis
Instances of a variant are named after the SET, not the variant — match doc instances on variantProperties, not name

A component whose root is FIXED at a stale size still LOOKS fine (children overflow, clipsContent off) but collapses every auto-layout parent it is placed in — audit roots with primaryAxisSizingMode !== AUTO after any resize()
HORIZONTAL auto-layout roots: primaryAxisSizingMode governs WIDTH, counterAxisSizingMode governs HEIGHT — a fixed-width row needs primary FIXED + counter AUTO (the reverse of a VERTICAL card)
appendChild into an INSTANCE (or anything inside one) throws and rolls back the whole script — layer decorations beside instances in a plain frame instead
EllipseNode.arcData with innerRadius 0 draws a filled pie wedge; a ring arc needs innerRadius ≈ 1 − thickness/radius and fill only (no stroke)

Gradient stops CAN bind variables (boundVariables.color on each stop) but the variable's alpha wins — fades to 0 must stay literal. An empty auto-layout frame used as a spacer is 100×100 until resized. Icon Button / Menu Item INSTANCE_SWAP fallbacks land on Icon/circle silently — check the grid has the Lucide name (grip-vertical, chart-*, shield-alert were missing). isExposedInstance needs the instance to carry properties.
